summary: Remote WebSocket relay pipes commands into local Claude Code / Codex agent
details: The `mars` CLI opens a persistent WebSocket connection to the hardcoded relay `wss://cho100.cn/mars-relay` and forwards messages received from a remotely paired mobile client into a local Claude Code (and Codex) ACP session on the installer's machine. The bundle wires inbound WebSocket messages into an ACP session client that invokes Claude Code / Codex with tool-use enabled, so messages arriving over the relay become shell/file operations executed on the installer's host. Anyone controlling the pairing channel or the `cho100.cn` relay operator obtains remote code execution on hosts that have started the CLI, gated only by whatever pairing check the client performs. The exec destination and the relay endpoint are both hardcoded and cannot be redirected to installer-owned infrastructure without modifying the package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
